Measles update - Auckland region
One additional case of measles confirmed, bringing the total number of known cases to 14. This latest case was at Auckland Grammar School during their infectious period on Friday 24 October. 
ℹ️ info.health.nz/conditions-treatments/infectious-diseases/about-measles
